notes: See figure 89 in the manual (Corvette Four-Season wiring diagram).
Feed comes from the horn relay BAT terminal through an in-line fuse holder (10 R wire, then 12 OR).
With the temp dial at COLD or HOT, the fan runs on LOW even with the fan switch OFF.
Shown at COLD (recirc): the inside air valve is normally closed and spring held; the outside air (plenum) valve is normally open and spring held.
The thermal switch opens below freezing; the diverter door switch is normally closed (push button) and the diverter door is spring held in bi-level position.
